title: L8 prepared graph v3
description: Candidate L8 prepared-graph transport, branch A/B discriminated relationally, not by schema combinators. Closed envelope: an inline v1 cluster-partition with adopted tightened to literal false, v1 investigation groups unchanged, and an optional proposalEvidence mirror of the real ProposalEvidence type. This wrapper is NOT a ClusterPartition and is never passed as-is to loaders or putPartition. All cross-field obligations (branch A/B requirements, fingerprint equalities, hex lowercase, cross-document joins, authority) are relational and documented in DESIGN.md; no JSON shape proves them. Strict harness subset: no pattern, no $ref, no combinators.

schemaVersion.description: Envelope schema version. The inline partition keeps its own schemaVersion 1.

partition.description: Inline v1 cluster-partition reference (schemas/cluster-partition-v1.schema.json, pinned). Only delta in this candidate: adopted tightened to literal false; the stored v1 schema is NOT modified. Branch A L3 conformance (regime A, parentLineageId null, maturity structural) is relational, not schema-expressible.
